description: Repairs r-def-cursor-dao/assign-without-edit-by-type: one transaction wrapped all cases and the table-type run stored N = 77 on ID 1, so later types read 77 after the refused assignment of 77 and could not show whether it applied. For a table-type (Index PK_T), a dynaset, a snapshot and a forward-only recordset over T, and a snapshot over "SELECT N FROM T GROUP BY N", each in ITS OWN BeginTrans that is rolled back after the recordset is closed: open, hold N, read N (the stored value); with no Edit assign N the value 77, read Errors, the field Value and EditMode; then Edit where it is accepted, assign 77, Update, read Value; Errors; CancelUpdate; close; Rollback; then a new snapshot of T reads ID and N for every row. Asks whether and how a Value assignment outside Edit or AddNew is refused per type, and its effect on the buffer, from a state each case shares. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
